g.title: {"@rid": "#460:4114", "@type": "CONFIRMS_SAFETY_OF", "@cat": "e", "@in": "#400:68", "@out": "#404:152", "ref": "5081", "Result": "THC ( Delta 9-tetrahydrocannabinol) content decreased by 26–85% after Shodhana, depending on the purification method, confirming significant removal of the narcotic principle. The greatest reduction (85%) was achieved by washing the leaves until free from turbidity followed by frying in ghee, indicating this as the most effective detoxification method."}

g.title: {"@rid": "#460:4116", "@type": "CONFIRMS_SAFETY_OF", "@cat": "e", "@in": "#400:69", "@out": "#404:154", "ref": "76448", "Result": "Protein content of the seeds decreased from 8.73% to 6.51%, while the protein content of the Shodhana milk increased from 4.76% to 7.99%, indicating the transfer of proteinaceous toxic constituents (including abrin) from the seeds into the processing medium during Shodhana."}

g.title: {"@rid": "#460:4117", "@type": "CONFIRMS_SAFETY_OF", "@cat": "e", "@in": "#400:68", "@out": "#404:155", "ref": "258077", "Result": "Microscopic analysis showed that Shodhana reduced glandular trichomes (the major site of tetrahydrocannabinol, THC, accumulation), along with fragmented fibers, reduced cystoliths, and shrunken/distorted epidermal cells, indicating structural modifications associated with reduced psychoactive THC content and detoxification."}

g.title: {"@rid": "#450:4103", "@type": "USES_MEDIA", "@cat": "e", "@in": "#396:73", "@out": "#416:0", "ref": "30254398", "Procedure": "Purified eggshell powder was sealed in earthen saucers and incinerated at 800 °C for 15 min, then the product was mixed with purified cinnabar (1/4 part), levigated with Aloe vera juice, pelletized, sealed in earthen saucers and incinerated at 800 °C for 15 min; this levigation–pelletization–incineration cycle was repeated until final bhasma was obtained."}

g.title: {"@rid": "#436:0", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the distance a person can walk in six minutes and is used to assess functional exercise capacity and endurance.", "name": "6 Min Walk Test (6Mwt)", "id": "1338"}

{"@rid": "#436:1", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures abnormal enlargement of the abdomen and is used to assess fluid, gas, organ enlargement, or other abdominal conditions.", "name": "Abdominal Distension", "id": "1339"}

{"@rid": "#436:2", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures abdominal dimensions or circumference and is used to monitor abdominal enlargement or changes during treatment.", "name": "Abdominal Measurements", "id": "1340"}

{"@rid": "#436:3", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Rates abnormal involuntary movements and is mainly used to assess movement disorders and treatment-related dyskinesia.", "name": "Abnormal Involuntary Movement Scale (Aims)", "id": "1341"}

{"@rid": "#436:4", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses independence in basic activities such as eating, dressing, bathing, and mobility.", "name": "Activities Of Daily Living", "id": "1342"}

{"@rid": "#436:5", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures alanine aminotransferase in blood and is used primarily to assess liver injury or dysfunction.", "name": "Alt", "id": "1343"}

{"@rid": "#436:6", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures functional impairment in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and tracks disease progression.", "name": "Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Functional Rating Scale-Revised (Alsfrs-R)", "id": "1344"}

{"@rid": "#436:7", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Includes measurements such as height, weight, and body circumferences to assess body composition and nutritional status.", "name": "Anthropometric Measurements", "id": "1345"}

{"@rid": "#436:8", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures circulating AMH and is used mainly to estimate ovarian reserve.", "name": "Anti-Mullerian Hormone (Amh) Value", "id": "1346"}

{"@rid": "#436:9", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Radiologically evaluates the urethra and is used to identify strictures, obstruction, or structural abnormalities.", "name": "Ascending Urethrogram (Aug)", "id": "1347"}

{"@rid": "#436:10", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Grades muscle tone and spasticity by assessing resistance during passive movement.", "name": "Ashworth Scale", "id": "1348"}

{"@rid": "#436:11", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures aspartate aminotransferase and is used to evaluate liver or tissue injury.", "name": "Ast", "id": "1349"}

{"@rid": "#436:12", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses asthma symptom control and the impact of asthma on daily functioning.", "name": "Asthma Control Questionnaire (Acq)", "id": "1350"}

{"@rid": "#436:13", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures antibodies or other laboratory markers associated with autoimmune disease and supports diagnosis or monitoring.", "name": "Autoimmune Markers", "id": "1351"}

{"@rid": "#436:14", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the average rate of urine flow and is used to assess urinary obstruction and voiding function.", "name": "Average Urine Flow Rate (Aufr)", "id": "1352"}

{"@rid": "#436:15", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Grades facial sensory loss and is used to assess facial numbness, particularly in trigeminal disorders.", "name": "Barrow Neurological Institute Facial Hypesthesia Scale", "id": "1353"}

{"@rid": "#436:16", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Grades facial pain severity and is used to evaluate pain in trigeminal neuralgia and related conditions.", "name": "Barrow Neurological Institute Pain Scale", "id": "1354"}

{"@rid": "#436:17", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures independence in activities of daily living and is commonly used to assess functional disability.", "name": "Barthel Index", "id": "1355"}

{"@rid": "#436:18", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Provides a structured assessment of wound characteristics and is used to monitor wound healing.", "name": "Bates-Jensen Wound Assessment Tool (Bwat)", "id": "1356"}

{"@rid": "#436:19", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures disease activity in ankylosing spondylitis using symptoms such as pain, stiffness, and fatigue.", "name": "Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index (Basdai)", "id": "1357"}

{"@rid": "#436:20", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures functional limitation in patients with ankylosing spondylitis.", "name": "Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Functional Index (Basfi)", "id": "1358"}

{"@rid": "#436:21", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures spinal mobility and physical limitation in ankylosing spondylitis.", "name": "Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Metrology Index (Basmi)", "id": "1359"}

{"@rid": "#436:22", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures the severity of depressive symptoms and is used to assess changes in depression", "name": "Beck Depression Inventory (Bdi)", "id": "1360"}

{"@rid": "#436:23", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the best vision achievable with appropriate correction and is used to evaluate visual function.", "name": "Best Corrected Visual Acuity (Bcva)", "id": "1361"}

{"@rid": "#436:24", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Includes laboratory measurements of biochemical processes and is used to evaluate organ function and metabolic status.", "name": "Biochemical Parameters", "id": "1362"}

{"@rid": "#436:25", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures disease activity in systemic vasculitis using clinical manifestations and laboratory findings.", "name": "Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score (Bvas-2010)", "id": "1363"}

{"@rid": "#436:26", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Refers to hematological measurements used to assess blood cell status and systemic health.", "name": "Blood Parameters", "id": "1364"}

{"@rid": "#436:27", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures arterial pressure and is used to assess cardiovascular status and hypertension.", "name": "Blood Pressure", "id": "1365"}

{"@rid": "#436:28", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures glucose concentration in blood and is used to assess glycemic status.", "name": "Blood Sugar Level", "id": "1366"}

{"@rid": "#436:29", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures circumference of body regions and is used to assess body composition and changes in size.", "name": "Body Circumferences", "id": "1367"}

{"@rid": "#436:30", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Relates body weight to height and is used to classify underweight, normal weight, overweight, and obesity.", "name": "Body Mass Index (Bmi)", "id": "1368"}

{"@rid": "#436:31", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "General physical measurements used to evaluate body composition, growth, and health status.", "name": "Body Parameters", "id": "1369"}

{"@rid": "#436:32", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures total body mass and is used to monitor nutritional status and treatment-related changes.", "name": "Body Weight", "id": "1370"}

{"@rid": "#436:33", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures bone mineral content and is used to assess bone strength and osteoporosis risk.", "name": "Bone Mineral Density (Bmd)", "id": "1371"}

{"@rid": "#436:34", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the duration a person can voluntarily hold their breath and is used as an indicator of respiratory capacity.", "name": "Breath Holding Time (Bht)", "id": "1372"}

{"@rid": "#436:35", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures serum CA-125 and is mainly used as a biomarker for monitoring certain ovarian conditions.", "name": "Ca 125 Test", "id": "1373"}

{"@rid": "#436:36", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "A traditional clinical test used to assess characteristics of a skin lesion, particularly scaling or surface changes.", "name": "Candle Grease Test", "id": "1374"}

{"@rid": "#436:37", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Records the principal symptoms of a disease and is used to assess disease severity and treatment response.", "name": "Cardinal Symptoms", "id": "1375"}

{"@rid": "#436:38", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures retinal thickness at the macula and is used to detect and monitor macular pathology.", "name": "Central Macular Thick (Cmt)", "id": "1376"}

{"@rid": "#436:39", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures opening of the cervix and is primarily used to assess progress of labour.", "name": "Cervical Dilatation", "id": "1377"}

{"@rid": "#436:40", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses the range of neck movement and is used to evaluate cervical stiffness and functional limitation.", "name": "Cervical Movements", "id": "1378"}

{"@rid": "#436:41", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "A condition-specific questionnaire used to assess health-related symptoms and functional impact.", "name": "Chiq", "id": "1379"}

{"@rid": "#436:42", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures blood cholesterol and is used to assess lipid status and cardiovascular risk.", "name": "Cholestrol Level", "id": "1380"}

{"@rid": "#436:43", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures quality of life impairment caused by chronic urticaria.", "name": "Chronic Urticaria Quality Of Life Questionnaire (Cu-Q2Ol) Score", "id": "1381"}

{"@rid": "#436:44", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Provides an overall clinician-rated assessment of illness severity and treatment-related improvement.", "name": "Clinical Global Impression (Cgi) Scale", "id": "1382"}

{"@rid": "#436:45", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Determines refractive error of the eye and is used to prescribe appropriate optical correction.", "name": "Clinical Refraction", "id": "1383"}

{"@rid": "#436:46", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses cognitive function and behavioural changes to evaluate neurological or psychiatric status.", "name": "Cognitive & Behavioral Parameters", "id": "1384"}

{"@rid": "#436:47", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Records whether pregnancy has occurred and is used to evaluate reproductive or fertility outcomes.", "name": "Conception", "id": "1385"}

{"@rid": "#436:48", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures an inflammatory biomarker and is used to assess systemic inflammation and treatment response.", "name": "C-Reactive Protein (Crp) Levels", "id": "1386"}

{"@rid": "#436:49", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures an enzyme released during muscle injury and is used to assess muscle damage.", "name": "Creatine Phosphokinase", "id": "1387"}

{"@rid": "#436:50", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures serum creatinine and is commonly used to assess kidney function.", "name": "Creatinine Level", "id": "1388"}

{"@rid": "#436:51", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Provides imaging of blood vessels and is used to identify stenosis, blockage, aneurysm, or vascular abnormalities.", "name": "Ct Angiography (Cta)", "id": "1389"}

{"@rid": "#436:52", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Standardizes grading of adverse events and treatment toxicity, particularly in clinical studies.", "name": "Ctcae Scale", "id": "1390"}

{"@rid": "#436:53", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses fetal heart rate and uterine activity to monitor fetal wellbeing during pregnancy and labour.", "name": "Ctg Findings", "id": "1391"}

{"@rid": "#436:54", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the dimensions of a cyst and is used to monitor its progression or response to treatment.", "name": "Cyst Size", "id": "1392"}

{"@rid": "#436:55", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures symptoms of depression, anxiety, and stress using a standardized questionnaire.", "name": "Dass-21", "id": "1393"}

{"@rid": "#436:56", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses the degree of fluid deficit and is used to monitor hydration status.", "name": "Dehydration", "id": "1394"}

{"@rid": "#436:57", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures the impact of skin disease on a patient's quality of life.", "name": "Dermatological Life Quality Index (Dlqi)", "id": "1395"}

{"@rid": "#436:58", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses achievement of age-appropriate developmental skills in children.", "name": "Developmental Milestone", "id": "1396"}

{"@rid": "#436:59", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures arterial pressure during cardiac relaxation and is used to assess cardiovascular status.", "name": "Diastolic Blood Pressure", "id": "1397"}

{"@rid": "#436:60", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the refractive power of an optical lens or eye and is used to determine refractive correction.", "name": "Dioptric Power", "id": "1398"}

{"@rid": "#436:61", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses the presence and severity of double vision and its effect on daily activities.", "name": "Diplopia Questionnaire (Dq)", "id": "1399"}

{"@rid": "#436:62", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "The DMIST (Diabetic foot Ulcer healing scale) tool was used for Wound assessment because it includes parameters like deep, maceration, infection, size, and tunneling, which are crucial for Wound care and impact healing.", "name": "Dmist Score", "id": "1400"}

{"@rid": "#436:63", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Detects or quantifies specific DNA sequences and is used for diagnosis or identification of infectious or genetic conditions.", "name": "Dna Pcr", "id": "1401"}

{"@rid": "#436:64", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures how long acute disease episodes persist and is used to evaluate disease severity and treatment response.", "name": "Duration Of Acute Episodes", "id": "1402"}

{"@rid": "#436:65", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures changes in itching severity over time and is used to monitor treatment response in pruritic disorders.", "name": "Dynamic Pruritus (Dps) Score", "id": "1403"}

{"@rid": "#436:66", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "The Epidermolysis Bullosa Disease Activity and Scarring Index (EBDASI) is a validated clinical scoring tool used to measure the severity, activity, and cumulative damage of epidermolysis bullosa (EB) across the skin, mucous membranes, and nails.", "name": "Ebdasi Score", "id": "1404"}

{"@rid": "#436:67", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Grades a patient's functional status and ability to perform daily activities.", "name": "Ecog Ps", "id": "1405"}

{"@rid": "#436:68", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses abnormal fluid accumulation in tissues and is used to monitor swelling and systemic disease.", "name": "Edema", "id": "1406"}

{"@rid": "#436:69", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses emotional and psychological status and is used to evaluate quality-of-life changes.", "name": "Emotional Wellbeing", "id": "1407"}

{"@rid": "#436:70", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses subjective energy and fatigue and is used to monitor general functional wellbeing.", "name": "Energy Level", "id": "1408"}

{"@rid": "#436:71", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures symptoms and functional limitations associated with chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy.", "name": "Eortc -Qlq- Cipn20", "id": "1409"}

{"@rid": "#436:72", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the rate of red-cell sedimentation and is used as a nonspecific marker of inflammation.", "name": "Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (Esr) Level", "id": "1410"}

{"@rid": "#436:73", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses quality of life and treatment-related symptoms in patients receiving taxane chemotherapy.", "name": "Fact-Taxane Score", "id": "1411"}

{"@rid": "#436:74", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures blood glucose after fasting and is used to assess diabetes and glycemic control.", "name": "Fasting Blood Sugar (Fbs) Level", "id": "1412"}

{"@rid": "#436:75", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures fetal cardiac rate and is used to assess fetal wellbeing.", "name": "Fetal Heart Rate (Fhr)", "id": "1413"}

{"@rid": "#436:189", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses the ability to participate in social and interpersonal activities", "name": "Social Functioning", "id": "1527"}

{"@rid": "#436:190", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Evaluates social wellbeing and participation in family, occupational, and community activities.", "name": "Social Health", "id": "1528"}

{"@rid": "#436:191", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Grades the severity or frequency of muscle spasms and is used to monitor neurological or muscular disorders.", "name": "Spasm Scale", "id": "1529"}

{"@rid": "#436:192", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses independence in daily activities in people with spinal cord injury.", "name": "Spinal Cord Independence Measure (Scim) Iii", "id": "1530"}

{"@rid": "#436:193", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures peripheral blood oxygen saturation and is used to assess oxygenation.", "name": "Spo2", "id": "1531"}

{"@rid": "#436:194", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses lumbosacral nerve-root irritation by observing pain during passive leg elevation.", "name": "Straight Leg Raise (Slr) Test", "id": "1532"}

{"@rid": "#436:195", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses inspiratory capacity and respiratory performance", "name": "Sustained Minimal Inspiration (Smi) Test", "id": "1533"}

{"@rid": "#436:196", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures arterial pressure during cardiac contraction and is used to assess cardiovascular status.", "name": "Systolic Blood Pressure", "id": "1534"}

{"@rid": "#436:197", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures tear-film stability and is used to evaluate dry-eye disease.", "name": "Tear Film Break-Up Time (Tbut)", "id": "1535"}

{"@rid": "#436:198", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures thyroid hormones and related markers to assess thyroid function.", "name": "Thyroid Profile", "id": "1536"}

{"@rid": "#436:199", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures total white blood cells and is used to assess infection, inflammation, or hematological abnormalities.", "name": "Total Leucocyte Count (Tlc)", "id": "1537"}

{"@rid": "#436:200", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the dimensions or area of an ulcer and is used to monitor wound healing.", "name": "Ulcer Size", "id": "1538"}

{"@rid": "#436:201", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses the clinical characteristics and healing status of an ulcerated wound.", "name": "Ulcerated Wound", "id": "1539"}

{"@rid": "#436:202", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Uses sound waves to visualize internal structures and is used for diagnosis and monitoring.", "name": "Ultrasonography (Usg)", "id": "1540"}

{"@rid": "#436:203", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Imaging examination of the urethra used to identify strictures, obstruction, or structural abnormalities.", "name": "Urethrogram", "id": "1541"}

{"@rid": "#436:204", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Evaluates urine for physical, chemical, and microscopic abnormalities to assess urinary and systemic disease.", "name": "Urine Examination", "id": "1542"}

{"@rid": "#436:205", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures small amounts of albumin in urine and is used for early detection of kidney damage, particularly in diabetes.", "name": "Urine Microalbumin Level", "id": "1543"}

{"@rid": "#436:206", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Detects urinary hCG and is used to determine pregnancy status.", "name": "Urine Pregnancy Test (Upt)", "id": "1544"}

{"@rid": "#436:207", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures severity and activity of urticaria based on wheals and itching over seven days.", "name": "Urticaria Activity Score (Uas7) Score", "id": "1545"}

{"@rid": "#436:208", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures subjective symptom intensity, commonly pain, using a visual scale.", "name": "Vas Score", "id": "1546"}

{"@rid": "#436:209", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses blood-vessel density or blood flow in a tissue or lesion and is used to evaluate vascular changes.", "name": "Vascularity", "id": "1547"}

{"@rid": "#436:210", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures symptom severity using verbal categories such as none, mild, moderate, and severe.", "name": "Verbal Rating Scale (Vrs)", "id": "1548"}

{"@rid": "#436:211", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the ability to see fine details and is a primary indicator of visual function.", "name": "Visual Acuity", "id": "1549"}

{"@rid": "#436:212", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures electrical responses of the visual pathway to assess optic nerve and visual pathway function.", "name": "Visual Evoked Potential (Vep)", "id": "1550"}

{"@rid": "#436:213", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses the area visible to the eye and is used to detect peripheral or localized visual-field defects.", "name": "Visual Field Evaluation", "id": "1551"}

{"@rid": "#436:214", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures body mass and is used to monitor nutritional status and changes during treatment.", "name": "Weight", "id": "1552"}

{"@rid": "#436:215", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures reduction in body weight and is used to assess metabolic, nutritional, or treatment-related changes.", "name": "Weight Loss", "id": "1553"}

{"@rid": "#436:216", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "A standardized questionnaire assessing quality of life across physical, psychological, social, and environmental domains.", "name": "Whoqol-Bref", "id": "1554"}

{"@rid": "#436:217", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Evaluates overall health-related quality of life across multiple domains.", "name": "Who-Quality Of Life Questionnaire", "id": "1555"}

{"@rid": "#436:218", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses binocular vision, fusion, and suppression using colored light perception.", "name": "Worth Four Dot Light Test (W4Lt)", "id": "1556"}

{"@rid": "#436:219", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Evaluates wound size, tissue condition, exudate, and healing progression.", "name": "Wound Assessment", "id": "1557"}

{"@rid": "#436:220", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Records structural abnormalities visible on radiographs and is used for diagnosis and monitoring.", "name": "X-Ray Findings", "id": "1558"}

{"@rid": "#436:221", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures chest circumference or respiratory movement during expiration and is used to assess chest mobility.", "name": "Chest Expiration", "id": "1559"}

{"@rid": "#436:222", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the time required to walk a specified distance and is used to assess mobility and functional capacity.", "name": "Walking Time", "id": "1560"}

{"@rid": "#436:223", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Quantifies knee swelling and is used to monitor joint inflammation or edema.", "name": "Knee Joint Swelling Measurement", "id": "1561"}

{"@rid": "#436:224", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Quantifies ankle swelling and is used to assess local inflammation or edema.", "name": "Ankle Joint Swelling Measurement", "id": "1562"}

{"@rid": "#436:225", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Uses psychiatric diagnostic criteria and the Childhood Autism Rating Scale to assess developmental and autism-related features.", "name": "DSM-V and CARS", "id": "1563"}

{"@rid": "#436:226", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Microscopically examines urine sediment for cells, crystals, casts, and microorganisms.", "name": "Urine Microscopy", "id": "1564"}

{"@rid": "#436:227", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses cervical mucus elasticity and is used as an indicator of estrogenic activity and the fertile period.", "name": "Spinnbarkeit Test", "id": "1565"}

{"@rid": "#436:228", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Examines crystallization of cervical mucus and is used as an indicator of ovulation and estrogen effect.", "name": "Fern Test", "id": "1566"}

{"@rid": "#436:229", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures pain, stiffness, and physical function in osteoarthritis, particularly of the hip and knee.", "name": "Western Ontario and McMaster Universities (Womac) Index", "id": "1567"}

{"@rid": "#436:230", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Grades pain elicited by palpation and is used to assess inflammatory or musculoskeletal activity.", "name": "Tenderness Score", "id": "1568"}

{"@rid": "#436:231", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures disability and functional limitation caused by neck pain.", "name": "Neck Disability Index (NDI)", "id": "1569"}

{"@rid": "#436:232", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the proportion or number of neutrophils and is used to assess infection and inflammatory responses.", "name": "Neutrophils", "id": "1570"}

{"@rid": "#436:233", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures lymphocyte count or proportion and is used to evaluate immune and hematological status.", "name": "Lymphocytes", "id": "1571"}

{"@rid": "#436:234", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the number of red blood cells and is used to assess anemia and other hematological conditions.", "name": "Red Blood Cell (RBC) count", "id": "1572"}

{"@rid": "#436:235", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures average red blood cell volume and helps classify types of anemia.", "name": "MCV (Mean Corpuscular Volume)", "id": "1573"}

{"@rid": "#436:236", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the average hemoglobin content of a red blood cell and assists in anemia classification.", "name": "MCH (Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin)", "id": "1574"}

{"@rid": "#436:237", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the concentration of hemoglobin within red blood cells and assists in evaluating anemia.", "name": "MCHC (Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration)", "id": "1575"}

{"@rid": "#436:238", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures walking capacity over a 50-minute period and is used to evaluate endurance and functional mobility.", "name": "50 Min Walk Test", "id": "1576"}

{"@rid": "#436:239", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures walking distance or capacity over one minute and is used for functional assessment.", "name": "One Min Walk Test", "id": "1577"}

{"@rid": "#436:240", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures the frequency and characteristics of sciatica symptoms and is used to monitor disease severity.", "name": "Sciatica Frequency Index (SFI)", "id": "1578"}

{"@rid": "#436:241", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures anti-streptolysin O antibodies and is used to detect evidence of recent streptococcal infection.", "name": "ASO (Anti-Streptolysin O) titre", "id": "1579"}

{"@rid": "#436:242", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures rheumatoid arthritis disease activity using joint findings and inflammatory markers.", "name": "DAS28 Score", "id": "1580"}

{"@rid": "#436:243", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses pain in individuals unable to reliably self-report using face, legs, activity, cry, and consolability.", "name": "The FLACC (Face, Legs, Activity, Cry, Consolability) scale", "id": "1581"}

{"@rid": "#436:244", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Uses facial expressions to help patients, especially children, communicate pain intensity.", "name": "Wong Baker Facial Grimace Scale", "id": "1582"}

{"@rid": "#436:245", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures lumbar spinal movement and is used to assess stiffness and functional limitation.", "name": "Lumbar spine mobility (LSM) test", "id": "1583"}

{"@rid": "#436:246", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures disability and functional outcome associated with low back disorders.", "name": "Low Back Outcome Score (LBOS)", "id": "1584"}

{"@rid": "#436:247", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures subjective symptom intensity, commonly pain, using a numerical range such as 0–10.", "name": "Numerical Rating Scale (NRS)", "id": "1585"}

{"@rid": "#436:248", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses lower-limb arterial circulation by observing colour changes with elevation and dependency.", "name": "Burger's Test", "id": "1586"}

{"@rid": "#436:249", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Quantifies the extent of scalp hair loss and is commonly used to assess alopecia severity.", "name": "Severity of Alopecia Tool (SALT) score", "id": "1587"}

{"@rid": "#436:250", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Provokes stress across the sacroiliac joints and is used to assess sacroiliac joint dysfunction.", "name": "Gaenslen's Test", "id": "1588"}

{"@rid": "#436:251", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Clinically assesses signs of diabetic peripheral neuropathy through sensory and reflex examination.", "name": "Diabetic Neuropathy Examination (DNE)", "id": "1589"}

{"@rid": "#436:252", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Screens for diabetic neuropathy using symptom assessment and physical examination.", "name": "Michigan Neuropathy Screening Instrument (MNSI)", "id": "1590"}

{"@rid": "#436:254", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses symptoms suggestive of diabetic peripheral neuropathy.", "name": "Diabetic Neuropathy Symptom Score (DNS)", "id": "1592"}

{"@rid": "#436:255", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Classifies gross motor ability and functional mobility, particularly in children with cerebral palsy.", "name": "Gross Motor Function Classification Scale (GMFCS)", "id": "1593"}

{"@rid": "#436:256", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures independence in routine activities of daily living.", "name": "Activity Daily Living (ADL) Scale", "id": "1594"}

{"@rid": "#436:257", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Assesses hip pain, function, mobility, and deformity to evaluate hip disability and treatment outcome.", "name": "Harris Hip Score", "id": "1595"}

{"@rid": "#436:258", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures symptoms of depression, anxiety, and stress.", "name": "Depression Anxiety Stress Scale", "id": "1596"}

{"@rid": "#436:259", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Quantifies inflammatory disease activity in ankylosing spondylitis using clinical symptoms and CRP.", "name": "Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Score with CRP (ASDAS-CRP)", "id": "1597"}

{"@rid": "#436:260", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Rates symptom intensity using descriptive categories such as mild, moderate, and severe.", "name": "Verbal Descriptive Scale (VDS)", "id": "1598"}

{"@rid": "#436:261", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures severity of post-thrombotic syndrome using symptoms and clinical signs of venous disease.", "name": "Villalta Score", "id": "1599"}

{"@rid": "#436:262", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Measures the impact of fibromyalgia on physical function, symptoms, and quality of life.", "name": "FM Impact Questionnaire (FIQ)", "id": "1600"}

{"@rid": "#436:263", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Clinician-rated scale used to quantify the severity of manic symptoms.", "name": "Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS)", "id": "1601"}

{"@rid": "#436:264", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures hip joint mobility in different directions and is used to assess restriction and functional improvement.", "name": "Range of movement of Hip Joint", "id": "1602"}

{"@rid": "#436:265", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Assesses symptoms, disability, and quality of life associated with lumbar spinal stenosis.", "name": "Fukushima lumbar spinal stenosis scale (FLS‑25) questionnaire", "id": "1603"}

{"@rid": "#436:266", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Radiological examination of the uterus and fallopian tubes used to assess uterine structure and tubal patency.", "name": "Hysterosapingography (HSG)", "id": "1604"}

{"@rid": "#436:267", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the dimensions or volume of uterine fibroids and is used to monitor their progression or reduction.", "name": "Fibroid Size", "id": "1605"}

{"@rid": "#436:268", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Serial ultrasonographic monitoring of ovarian follicles used to assess follicular growth and ovulation.", "name": "Follicular Study", "id": "1606"}

{"@rid": "#436:269", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Examines cervical mucus and sperm after intercourse and was historically used to evaluate sperm-mucus interaction and fertility.", "name": "Post-coital Test", "id": "1607"}

{"@rid": "#436:270", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Measures the thickness of the uterine lining and is used to assess endometrial development and reproductive status.", "name": "Endometrial Thickness", "id": "1608"}

{"@rid": "#436:271", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Quantifies eczema severity based on affected body area and the intensity of clinical signs.", "name": "Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI)", "id": "1609"}

{"@rid": "#436:272", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "A non-parametric statistical test used to compare paired measurements, such as before- and after-treatment scores, when data are not assumed to be normally distributed.", "name": "Wilcoxon signed-rank test", "id": "1610"}

{"@rid": "#436:273", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Alzheimer’s Disease Assessment Scale–Cognitive Subscale (ADAS-Cog) is a standardized neuropsychological assessment tool used to measure cognitive impairment, particularly in patients with Alzheimer’s disease and dementia.", "name": "ADAS-cog", "id": "2048"}

{"@rid": "#436:274", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "Sexual parameters are clinical measures used to assess different aspects of sexual function and performance.", "name": "Sexual Parameters", "id": "2049"}

{"@rid": "#436:276", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Electromyography (EMG) is a diagnostic test that evaluates the health and function of your skeletal muscles and the nerves that control them.", "name": "Integral Emg", "id": "2051"}

{"@rid": "#436:277", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Subjective", "Description": "The Perceived Stress Scale (PSS) is a psychological tool used to measure how stressful an individual appraises their life situations to be.", "name": "Perceived Stress Score (Pss)", "id": "2052"}

{"@rid": "#436:278", "@type": "Assessment_Parameter", "@cat": "v", "Type": "Objective", "Description": "Root Mean Square Electromyography is a mathematical calculation used to measure the amplitude and power of an electrical signal produced by skeletal muscles during an EMG test.", "name": "Rms Emg", "id": "2053"}

{"@rid": "#424:0", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ayurvedic description of inability or difficulty in obtaining normal sleep, commonly associated with aggravated Vata and disturbed mental factors.", "name": "Anidra", "id": "834"}

{"@rid": "#424:1", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder in which Apana Vata obstructs the normal functioning of Vyana Vata, leading to disturbed movement and circulation-related functions.", "name": "Apanavrita Vyanavata", "id": "835"}

{"@rid": "#424:2", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata-dominant headache disorder characterized by severe pain affecting one half of the head, often occurring episodically.", "name": "Ardhavabhedaka", "id": "836"}

{"@rid": "#424:3", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "In Ayurveda, Ardita is a disease with functional disturbances affecting the Uthamanga (head) and stands close with the symptoms of Bell's palsy. It is narrated as one among the Asheeti Vata Vikaras (80 types of typical vata predominant diseases).", "name": "Ardita", "id": "837"}

{"@rid": "#424:4", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder characterized by reduced quantity or deficient formation of Artava (menstrual tissue), often presenting with scanty or delayed menstruation.", "name": "Artava Kshaya", "id": "838"}

{"@rid": "#424:5", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A state of depletion of Asthi (bone tissue) and Majja (marrow/nerve-related tissue) associated with weakness and degenerative manifestations.", "name": "Asthi-Majja Kshaya", "id": "839"}

{"@rid": "#424:6", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder in which aggravated Vata is located in the bone and marrow tissues, producing pain, weakness, and degenerative symptoms.", "name": "Asthimajjagata-Vata", "id": "840"}

{"@rid": "#424:7", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Pathological disturbance of the channels responsible for nourishment and functioning of bone tissue (Asthi).", "name": "Asthivaha Srotodushti", "id": "841"}

{"@rid": "#424:8", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Vata disorders produced by obstruction of the normal movement of Vata by another Dosha, tissue, or bodily factor.", "name": "Avarana Janya Vata Vyadhi", "id": "842"}

{"@rid": "#424:9", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder resulting from trauma to the urinary/bladder region considered a vital anatomical site (Basti Marma).", "name": "Bastimarm Abhighataja Vatavyadhi", "id": "843"}

{"@rid": "#424:10", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic description of a mass or nodular swelling involving the testicular region (Beejakosha).", "name": "Beejakosha Granthi", "id": "844"}

{"@rid": "#424:11", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ayurvedic term for fracture or disruption of the continuity of a bone, generally associated with trauma.", "name": "Bhagna", "id": "845"}

{"@rid": "#424:12", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Infertility described as resulting from depletion or inadequate nourishment of the bodily tissues (Dhatus) affecting reproductive capacity.", "name": "Dhatukshayajanya Vandhyata", "id": "846"}

{"@rid": "#424:13", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A chronic or complicated form of nasal disorder with persistent discharge and inflammation, described under Pratishyaya.", "name": "Dushta Pratishyaya", "id": "847"}

{"@rid": "#424:14", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A chronic or contaminated/non-healing wound characterized by abnormal discharge, inflammation, pain, or delayed healing.", "name": "Dushta Vrana", "id": "848"}

{"@rid": "#424:15", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ekakushtha is a type of Kshudrakushtha representing minor skin disorders that are typically less severe but still require attention.", "name": "Ekakushtha", "id": "849"}

{"@rid": "#424:16", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Vata disorders arising from depletion of bodily tissues, allowing Vata to become aggravated and produce pain, weakness, and functional disturbances.", "name": "Dhatukshayajanya Vatavyadhi", "id": "850"}

{"@rid": "#424:17", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A reproductive disorder characterized by recurrent loss or expulsion of pregnancy, resulting in inability to sustain pregnancy.", "name": "Garbhasravi Vandhyatva", "id": "851"}

{"@rid": "#424:18", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder of Grahani, the functional site of digestion and intestinal retention, characterized by impaired digestion and irregular bowel movements.", "name": "Grahani Dosha", "id": "852"}

{"@rid": "#424:19", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata-dominant condition characterized by stiffness, restricted movement, and pain in the neck region.", "name": "Greevastambha", "id": "853"}

{"@rid": "#424:20", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic Vata disorder characterized by pain radiating from the lower back through the buttock and along the leg, often associated with stiffness and restricted movement.", "name": "Gridhrasi", "id": "854"}

{"@rid": "#424:21", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Indralupta is a disease characterized by patches of hair loss spread throughout the body and scalp.", "name": "Indralupta", "id": "855"}

{"@rid": "#424:22", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A condition described by accumulation of fluid within the abdominal cavity, producing abdominal distension and associated systemic manifestations.", "name": "Jalodara", "id": "856"}

{"@rid": "#424:23", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Swelling caused predominantly by aggravated Kapha, characterized by heaviness, pallor, coldness, and relatively stable edema.", "name": "Kaphaja Shotha", "id": "857"}

{"@rid": "#424:24", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Kapha-dominant form of Unmada (mental disorder) characterized by lethargy, excessive sleep, heaviness, and diminished mental activity.", "name": "Kaphaja Unmada", "id": "858"}

{"@rid": "#424:25", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A blistering skin disorder involving all three Doshas with predominance of Kapha and Pitta, producing eruptions or blisters.", "name": "Kapha-Pitta Dominant Tridoshaja Visphota", "id": "859"}

{"@rid": "#424:26", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A condition in which Kapha obstructs the normal function of Udana Vata, affecting speech, effort, strength, and upward bodily functions.", "name": "Kaphavruta Udanavata", "id": "860"}

{"@rid": "#424:27", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder caused by obstruction of Vata by aggravated Kapha, resulting in impaired Vata movement and associated heaviness and sluggishness.", "name": "Kaphavruta Vata", "id": "861"}

{"@rid": "#424:28", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A menstrual disorder characterized by painful menstruation, commonly associated with aggravated Vata.", "name": "Kashtartava", "id": "862"}

{"@rid": "#424:29", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder characterized by stiffness, restricted movement, and pain in the lower back region.", "name": "Kati Graha", "id": "863"}

{"@rid": "#424:30", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A degenerative Vata disorder affecting the lumbosacral joints, producing pain, stiffness, and restricted movement.", "name": "Kati Sandhigata Vata", "id": "864"}

{"@rid": "#424:31", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Kitibha Kushta, which is characterized by reddish patches, indurated, Itching, and Scaling.", "name": "Kitibha Kushta", "id": "865"}

{"@rid": "#424:32", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An acute skin manifestation characterized by raised, itchy eruptions or wheals, associated with Dosha disturbance and resembling urticarial lesions.", "name": "Kotha", "id": "866"}

{"@rid": "#424:33", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ksheena Shukra is one of the “Shukradushti” (~vitiation of sperm) where Shukra Dhatu (~reproductive tissue) is of poor quality.", "name": "Ksheena Shukra", "id": "867"}

{"@rid": "#424:34", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Prameha disorder characterized by frequent urination with urine having characteristics resembling honey, traditionally associated with deranged metabolism and predominantly Vata involvement.", "name": "Madhumeha", "id": "868"}

{"@rid": "#424:35", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A chronic, difficult-to-heal wound associated with Madhumeha, characterized by delayed healing and abnormal tissue changes.", "name": "Madhumehajanaya Dushta Vrana", "id": "869"}

{"@rid": "#424:36", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A visual disorder described as disturbance or impairment of vision associated with Madhumeha, reflecting ocular complications of the condition.", "name": "Madhumehajanya Timira", "id": "870"}

{"@rid": "#424:37", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A group of severe or major forms of Kushtha (chronic skin disorders) described in classical Ayurvedic texts.", "name": "Maha Kushta", "id": "871"}
{"@rid": "#424:38", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Mandala Kushtha a type of Maha Kushtha is a chronic of Kushtha", "name": "Mandala Kushtha", "id": "872"}

{"@rid": "#424:39", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder in which aggravated Vata is located in Mamsa (muscle tissue), producing pain, stiffness, twitching, or weakness.", "name": "Mansagata Vata", "id": "873"}

{"@rid": "#424:40", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder involving abnormal accumulation or disturbance of Meda (adipose/fat tissue), associated with metabolic imbalance and excessive body weight.", "name": "Medoroga", "id": "874"}

{"@rid": "#424:41", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic urinary disorder characterized by painful or difficult urination, often associated with inflammation or obstruction of the urinary tract.", "name": "Mootrakruchchhra", "id": "875"}

{"@rid": "#424:42", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "In Ayurveda, Mutraghata has been defined as a syndrome of obstructive urinary pathology due to deranged function of Vata Dosha, particularly Apana Vata (a type of Vata responsible for excretory function).", "name": "Mutraghata", "id": "876"}

{"@rid": "#424:43", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A condition characterized by retention or obstruction of urine, with incomplete or delayed urinary evacuation.", "name": "Mutrasanga", "id": "877"}

{"@rid": "#424:44", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder in which aggravated Vata is localized in the large intestine (Pakvashaya), producing abdominal pain, constipation, distension, and altered bowel function.", "name": "Pakvashayagata Vata", "id": "878"}

{"@rid": "#424:45", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A group of Ayurvedic metabolic and urinary disorders characterized by excessive or abnormal urination and derangement of bodily tissues, with Madhumeha representing an important subtype.", "name": "Prameha", "id": "879"}

{"@rid": "#424:46", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder caused by obstruction of Vyana Vata by Prana Vata, disturbing normal circulation and coordinated bodily movements.", "name": "Prana Avrutta Vyana", "id": "880"}

{"@rid": "#424:47", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A classical wasting disorder characterized by progressive tissue depletion, weakness, cough, fever, and respiratory or systemic manifestations.", "name": "Rajayakshma", "id": "881"}

{"@rid": "#424:48", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A condition characterized by passage of blood with loose stools, reflecting involvement of Rakta and intestinal pathology.", "name": "Raktatisara", "id": "882"}

{"@rid": "#424:49", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder in which Rakta (blood tissue) obstructs the normal movement of Vata, producing pain and vascular or inflammatory manifestations.", "name": "Raktavrita Vata", "id": "883"}

{"@rid": "#424:50", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A degenerative Vata disorder affecting the joints, characterized by pain, stiffness, restricted movement, and sometimes joint crepitus.", "name": "Sandhigata Vata", "id": "884"}

{"@rid": "#424:51", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Disorders arising from excessive nourishment, overnutrition, and accumulation of Doshas and bodily tissues, commonly associated with obesity and metabolic disease.", "name": "Santarpanajanya Vyadhi", "id": "885"}

{"@rid": "#424:52", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A severe state of loss of consciousness or profound collapse of mental and physical functions, described as a serious Vata-related condition.", "name": "Sanyasa", "id": "886"}

{"@rid": "#424:53", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder in which aggravated Vata affects the entire body, producing generalized pain, stiffness, weakness, or functional impairment.", "name": "Sarvanga Gatavata Vyadhi", "id": "887"}

{"@rid": "#424:54", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A generalized Vata disorder characterized by widespread involvement of the body with pain, stiffness, weakness, and impaired movement.", "name": "Sarvangavata", "id": "888"}

{"@rid": "#424:55", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A generalized disorder of the oral cavity, involving widespread inflammation or lesions of the oral tissues.", "name": "Sarvasara Mukharoga", "id": "889"}

{"@rid": "#424:56", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic ocular disorder characterized by whitish discoloration or opacity affecting ocular structures, resulting in visual disturbance.", "name": "Savrinashukla", "id": "890"}

{"@rid": "#424:57", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A skin disorder characterized by itchy, raised eruptions associated with exposure to cold, traditionally involving Vata and Kapha with Pitta involvement.", "name": "Sheethapitta", "id": "891"}

{"@rid": "#424:58", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder arising from trauma to vital structures of the head (Shiro Marma), potentially producing neurological or sensory disturbances.", "name": "Shiromarmabhighata", "id": "892"}

{"@rid": "#424:59", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A form of Arsha (haemorrhoidal disorder) associated with bleeding, characterized particularly by rectal bleeding.", "name": "Shonitarsha", "id": "893"}

{"@rid": "#424:60", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ayurvedic term for inflammatory swelling or edema, characterized by enlargement, discomfort, and Dosha-specific features.", "name": "Shotha", "id": "894"}

{"@rid": "#424:61", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder affecting the blood vessels or vascular channels (Sira), producing pain, obstruction, or abnormal vascular manifestations.", "name": "Siragata Vata", "id": "895"}

{"@rid": "#424:62", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic disorder characterized by excessive accumulation of Meda and increased body bulk, accompanied by impaired metabolism and reduced physical capacity.", "name": "Sthaulya", "id": "896"}

{"@rid": "#424:63", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A metabolic form of Prameha characterized by excess body tissue and obesity-associated manifestations, commonly involving Kapha and Meda.", "name": "Sthula Prameha", "id": "897"}

{"@rid": "#424:64", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A headache disorder characterized by pain that increases with the rising intensity of the sun and decreases as the sun sets, traditionally associated with Vata-Pitta.", "name": "Suryavarta", "id": "898"}

{"@rid": "#424:65", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Tamaka Shwasa is a type of Shwasa Roga (respiratory disease) affecting the Pranavaha Srotas and characterized by Pratiloma Vayu (prolonged expiration), Ghurghuraka (wheeze), Ativa Tivra Vagam Ca Shwasam Pranaprapidakam (dyspnoea of exceedingly deep velocity, which was immensely injurious to life).", "name": "Tamaka Shwasa", "id": "899"}

{"@rid": "#424:66", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic neurological condition described by involuntary or abnormal movements of the body, associated predominantly with aggravated Vata.", "name": "Tandava Roga", "id": "900"}

{"@rid": "#424:67", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic ocular disorder characterized by progressive disturbance or diminution of vision, described according to the stage and Dosha involvement.", "name": "Timira", "id": "901"}

{"@rid": "#424:68", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A form of Jaundice (Kamala) described as affecting both pathways or systems involved in the movement of bile, producing generalized yellow discoloration and related symptoms.", "name": "Ubhayapatha Ashrita Swatantra Kamala", "id": "902"}

{"@rid": "#424:69", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A gynecological disorder caused by upward or abnormal movement of Apana Vata, leading to menstrual pain, obstruction, or disturbed reproductive functions.", "name": "Udavarta Yonivyapada", "id": "903"}

{"@rid": "#424:70", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic description of a tumor-like mass (Arbuda) occurring on the left side of the body, particularly the left flank or thoracic region depending on the clinical context.", "name": "Vamaparshwa Arbuda", "id": "904"}

{"@rid": "#424:71", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ayurvedic term for female infertility, describing inability to achieve or sustain conception due to disturbance of reproductive factors.", "name": "Vandhyatva", "id": "905"}

{"@rid": "#424:72", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An ocular condition characterized by contraction or abnormal narrowing of the eyelid, potentially interfering with normal eyelid movement and eye protection.", "name": "Vartma Sankocha", "id": "906"}

{"@rid": "#424:73", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder of Rakta (blood tissue) caused predominantly by Vata and Pitta vitiation, producing inflammatory, vascular, or skin-related manifestations.", "name": "Vata Pitta Pradhana Rakta Pradoshaja Vikara", "id": "907"}

{"@rid": "#424:74", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A broad group of disorders caused predominantly by aggravated or disturbed Vata, commonly presenting with pain, stiffness, weakness, tremors, or impaired movement.", "name": "Vata Vyadhi", "id": "908"}

{"@rid": "#424:75", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Swelling predominantly caused by Vata aggravation, typically associated with pain, variable swelling, dryness, and irregularity.", "name": "Vataja Shopha", "id": "909"}

{"@rid": "#424:76", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder caused by interaction of aggravated Vata and Rakta, classically presenting with severe joint pain, redness, swelling, and burning sensations.", "name": "Vatarakta", "id": "910"}

{"@rid": "#424:77", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "a skin problem mentioned in Ayurvedic literature with Kapha and Pitta morbidly/pathology", "name": "Vicharchika", "id": "911"}

{"@rid": "#424:78", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A wasting or depletion disorder characterized by loss of strength and bodily tissues, generally associated with prolonged illness or Dosha imbalance.", "name": "Vikshay", "id": "912"}

{"@rid": "#424:79", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A severe or deep form of Vatarakta, in which Vata and Rakta involvement extends into deeper tissues and produces intense pain and inflammation.", "name": "Gambhira Vatarakta", "id": "913"}

{"@rid": "#424:80", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A type of Kushtha characterized by large, pale or reddish-white lesions resembling the petals of a lotus (Pundarika).", "name": "Pundarik Kushtha", "id": "914"}

{"@rid": "#424:81", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A type of Kushtha characterized by large, pale or reddish-white lesions resembling the petals of a lotus (Pundarika).", "name": "Mutrasmari", "id": "915"}

{"@rid": "#424:82", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A urinary disorder described as abnormal constriction or obstruction involving the urinary bladder and urinary passage, leading to disturbed urine flow.", "name": "Basti Kundalika", "id": "916"}

{"@rid": "#424:83", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder affecting the knee joint, characterized by pain, stiffness, restricted movement, and degenerative changes.", "name": "Janu Sandhigata Vata", "id": "917"}

{"@rid": "#424:84", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder characterized by stiffness and restricted movement of the neck, commonly involving the cervical region.", "name": "Manyasthambha", "id": "918"}

{"@rid": "#424:85", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A condition characterized by pain in the lower back or lumbar region, predominantly attributed to aggravated Vata.", "name": "Katishool", "id": "919"}

{"@rid": "#424:86", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ayurvedic term for haemorrhoids, characterized by abnormal growths or swellings in the anal region, which may be painful or bleeding.", "name": "Arsha", "id": "920"}

{"@rid": "#424:87", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder localized in the bones and structures of the cervical region, producing neck pain, stiffness, and restricted movement.", "name": "Greeva Asthigatavata", "id": "921"}

{"@rid": "#424:88", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A broad group of urinary disorders involving abnormalities in urine formation, flow, quantity, or elimination.", "name": "Mootra Dosha Vikar", "id": "922"}

{"@rid": "#424:89", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder characterized by stiffness and restricted movement in the Trika region, corresponding broadly to the lumbosacral/pelvic area.", "name": "Trikagraha", "id": "923"}

{"@rid": "#424:90", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Khalitya in Ayurveda is a disease in which Pitta, combining with Vata and entering the pores of the hairs (hair follicles), causes hair fall, and then Kapha, along with Rakta, obstructs the pores of those hairs, making it impossible for other hair to grow.", "name": "Khalitya", "id": "924"}

{"@rid": "#424:91", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder associated with impaired development or reduced strength in childhood, involving inadequate growth and functional capacity.", "name": "Bala Samvardhana Janya Vata Vikruti", "id": "925"}

{"@rid": "#424:92", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder attributed to depletion of Mastulunga, traditionally associated with brain/cranial tissue, producing neurological manifestations.", "name": "Mastulunga Kshaya Janya Vatavyadhi", "id": "926"}

{"@rid": "#424:93", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disorder in which aggravated Vata is localized in muscle tissue, causing pain, stiffness, twitching, or weakness.", "name": "Mamsagata Vata", "id": "927"}

{"@rid": "#424:94", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata-dominant form of Unmada (mental disorder) characterized by restlessness, abnormal speech or behaviour, fear, and disturbed mental activity.", "name": "Vatika Unmada", "id": "928"}

{"@rid": "#424:95", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A disease that usually affects the amsa sandhi (shoulder joint) is produced by vitiated vata dosha.", "name": "Avabahuka", "id": "929"}

{"@rid": "#424:96", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Pakshagata is an important Vatavyadhi described under Vataja nanatmaja vyadhi and Mahavatavyadhi can manifest either due to dhatukshaya and margavarana", "name": "Pakshagata", "id": "930"}

{"@rid": "#424:97", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Kaphavrutavyana Vata is an Ayurvedic pathological condition that occurs when Kapha dosha obstructs the normal functioning of Vyana Vata.", "name": "Kaphavrutavyana Vata", "id": "931"}

{"@rid": "#424:98", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Pathological disturbance of the Artavavaha Srotas, the channels responsible for formation and transport of reproductive/menstrual tissue, causing menstrual and fertility-related disorders.", "name": "Artavavaha Srotodushti", "id": "932"}

{"@rid": "#424:99", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic description of a tumor-like mass arising in the uterus (Garbhashaya), representing an abnormal uterine growth.", "name": "Garbhashaya Arbuda", "id": "933"}

{"@rid": "#424:100", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An Ayurvedic term used to describe childhood developmental delays and growth disorders", "name": "Bala Samvardhana Vikara", "id": "934"}

{"@rid": "#424:101", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "In Ayurveda, Mutramarga Sankocha can be understood as constriction or narrowing of the urinary passage due to derangement of Doshas, predominantly Vata.", "name": "Mutramarga Sankocha", "id": "935"}

{"@rid": "#424:102", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ayurvedic description of loss or severe impairment of vision caused by Vata aggravation following trauma to the eye or visual apparatus.", "name": "Abhighatajanya Vataprakopaj Drishtinash", "id": "943"}

{"@rid": "#424:103", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A digestive disorder described as impaired digestion with stagnation of improperly digested food, associated mainly with aggravated Kapha and Vata.", "name": "Alasaka", "id": "1334"}

{"@rid": "#424:104", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A systemic disorder caused by Ama associated with aggravated Vata, characterized mainly by joint pain, stiffness, and swelling.", "name": "Amavata", "id": "1335"}

{"@rid": "#424:105", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A Vata disorder described by pain and stiffness affecting the neck and shoulders, with possible radiation toward the head and upper limbs.", "name": "Anantavata", "id": "1336"}

{"@rid": "#424:106", "@type": "Ayurvedic_Diagnosis", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A condition involving widespread bodily dysfunction arising from trauma (Aghata), with predominant involvement of Vata.", "name": "Aghataja Sarvangaroga", "id": "2509"}
