{"@rid": "#420:0", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Acute prolapsed inter-vertebral disc (IVDP) is a painful condition that requires immediate treatment by conservative or surgical management. Though majority of patients show remission in symptoms with conservative treatment, regression of herniated disc with non-surgical management has been rarely reported.", "name": "Acute Prolapsed Inter-Vertebral Disc", "id": "702"}

{"@rid": "#420:1", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Acute upper limb ischemia (AULI) is a medical and surgical emergency involving sudden decrease in limb perfusion resulting in threat for limb viability. The approximate incidence of AULI is 1.5 cases/10,000 people per year.", "name": "Acute Upper Limb Ischemia", "id": "703"}

path.style: stroke: #2166a0; stroke-width: 0.5

g.title: {"@rid": "#420:2", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Alopecia is the medical term for hair loss. It can mean small round patches missing from the scalp (alopecia areata), total loss of head hair (alopecia totalis), or loss of all body hair (alopecia universalis).", "name": "Alopecia", "id": "704"}

{"@rid": "#420:3", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) affects human life in various ways. ALS with multifocal onset might exhibit muscle stiffness and muscle weakness of upper and lower limbs, muscle twitching, atrophy, falling/tripping, slurred speech, difficulty in swallowing and loss of dexterity.", "name": "Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis", "id": "705"}

{"@rid": "#420:4", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is a chronic inflammatory disorder that primarily involves the sacroiliac joints and the axial skeleton. There is also a variable involvement of peripheral joints and articular structures.", "name": "Ankylosing Spondylitis", "id": "706"}

{"@rid": "#420:5", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Anti-phospholipid antibody (APLA) syndrome is defined by the presence of thrombo-embolic complications and pregnancy morbidity in the presence of persistently increased titers of APLA syndrome.", "name": "Antiphospholipid Antibody Syndrome", "id": "707"}

{"@rid": "#420:6", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "AIP is a rare disorder, its exact cause is unknown, but it is thought to be caused by the body's immune system attacking the pancreas and it responds to steroid therapy only.", "name": "Autoimmune Pancreatitis", "id": "708"}

{"@rid": "#420:7", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Avascular necrosis (AVN) of the bone is a condition characterized by the death or necrosis of bone tissue, accompanied by structural changes. It is also referred to as osteonecrosis or ischemic necrosis of the bone. It is mostly seen in patients having a history of excessive alcohol and high-dose steroid medications.", "name": "Avascular Necrosis", "id": "709"}

{"@rid": "#420:8", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Bell's palsy or Facial nerve palsy is a condition that causes temporary weakness or paralysis of the muscles in the face.", "name": "Bell's Palsy", "id": "710"}

{"@rid": "#420:9", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "BPH is a nonmalignant enlargement of the prostate gland caused by excessive growth of the prostatic tissue and is the most common benign neoplasm of aging men mainly above 40 years.", "name": "Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia", "id": "711"}

{"@rid": "#420:10", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Bleeding piles (hemorrhoids) are swollen, inflamed blood vessels in the rectum or anus that often produce painless, bright red blood during bowel movements.", "name": "Bleeding Piles", "id": "712"}

{"@rid": "#420:11", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Bronchial asthma is a long-term lung disease that inflames and narrows the airways. It causes recurring bouts of wheezing, chest tightness, shortness of breath, and coughing.", "name": "Bronchial Asthma", "id": "713"}

{"@rid": "#420:12", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Central serous retinopathy (CSR), or central serous chorioretinopathy, occurs when fluid leaks under the retina, forming a small detachment that blurs or distorts central vision.", "name": "Central Serous Retinopathy", "id": "714"}

{"@rid": "#420:13", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Cerebral palsy is a group of permanent movement and posture disorders caused by abnormal development or damage to the developing brain, usually before or during birth.", "name": "Cerebral Palsy", "id": "715"}

{"@rid": "#420:14", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Cervical spondylosis is a degenerative condition of the cervical spine caused by age-related changes in the vertebrae, intervertebral discs, and surrounding structures. It may cause neck pain, stiffness, and restricted movement.", "name": "Cervical Spondylosis", "id": "716"}

{"@rid": "#420:15", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Cervical spondylotic myelopathy is a neurological condition caused by compression of the spinal cord due to degenerative changes in the cervical spine. It may result in weakness, sensory disturbances, impaired coordination, and difficulty walking.", "name": "Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy", "id": "717"}

{"@rid": "#420:16", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy is nerve damage resulting from certain anticancer drugs. It commonly presents with numbness, tingling, burning pain, weakness, or altered sensation, particularly in the hands and feet.", "name": "Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy", "id": "718"}

{"@rid": "#420:17", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Chronic alcoholism refers to prolonged and excessive alcohol consumption associated with dependence and adverse physical, psychological, and social consequences. It can affect multiple organs and may lead to neurological and metabolic complications.", "name": "Chronic Alchoholism", "id": "719"}

{"@rid": "#420:18", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Chronic low back pain is persistent or recurrent pain affecting the lower back for an extended period. It may be associated with spinal degeneration, muscular problems, nerve involvement, or other underlying conditions.", "name": "Chronic Low Back Pain", "id": "720"}

{"@rid": "#420:19", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Chronic lymphocytic leukemia is a type of blood cancer characterized by the abnormal accumulation of mature but functionally impaired lymphocytes, most commonly B lymphocytes. It generally progresses slowly and may initially produce few symptoms.", "name": "Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia", "id": "721"}

{"@rid": "#420:20", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A chronic non-healing ulcer is a wound that fails to heal through the normal stages of tissue repair. It may persist because of factors such as poor blood supply, infection, diabetes, or repeated trauma.", "name": "Chronic Non-Healing Ulcer", "id": "722"}

{"@rid": "#420:21", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Chronic sinusitis is persistent inflammation of the paranasal sinuses lasting for an extended period. It commonly causes nasal obstruction, nasal discharge, facial pressure or pain, and reduced sense of smell.", "name": "Chronic Sinusitis", "id": "723"}

{"@rid": "#420:22", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Chronic urticaria is a condition characterized by recurrent episodes of itchy wheals (hives), with or without swelling, occurring without a consistently identifiable external trigger.", "name": "Chronic Urticaria", "id": "724"}

{"@rid": "#420:23", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Coma is a prolonged state of profound unconsciousness in which an individual cannot be awakened and does not respond normally to external stimuli. It may result from severe brain injury, stroke, metabolic disturbances, poisoning, or other serious conditions.", "name": "Coma", "id": "725"}

{"@rid": "#420:24", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "COVID-19 is an infectious disease caused by the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). It primarily affects the respiratory system but can involve multiple organs and produce symptoms ranging from mild illness to severe disease.", "name": "Covid-19", "id": "726"}

{"@rid": "#420:25", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Depression is a mental health disorder characterized by persistent sadness or low mood, loss of interest or pleasure, and associated emotional, cognitive, behavioural, and physical symptoms that can interfere with daily functioning.", "name": "Depression", "id": "727"}

{"@rid": "#420:26", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels resulting from inadequate insulin production, impaired insulin action, or a combination of both. Persistent hyperglycaemia can lead to complications affecting multiple organs.", "name": "Diabetes Mellitus", "id": "728"}

{"@rid": "#420:27", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A diabetic foot ulcer is a chronic open wound occurring on the foot in individuals with diabetes. It is commonly associated with diabetic neuropathy, impaired circulation, and delayed wound healing.", "name": "Diabetic Foot Ulcer", "id": "729"}

{"@rid": "#420:28", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Diabetic retinopathy is a complication of diabetes that affects the blood vessels of the retina. Progressive retinal damage can cause visual disturbances and, in advanced cases, significant vision loss.", "name": "Diabetic Retinopathy", "id": "730"}

{"@rid": "#420:29", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Diplopia, commonly known as double vision, is a visual disturbance in which a person perceives two images of a single object. It may occur due to abnormalities involving the eyes, ocular muscles, or the nerves controlling eye movement.", "name": "Diplopia", "id": "731"}

{"@rid": "#420:30", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Dyslipidemia is an abnormal level or composition of lipids in the blood, including elevated cholesterol or triglycerides and/or reduced high-density lipoprotein cholesterol. It is an important risk factor for cardiovascular disease.", "name": "Dyslipidemia", "id": "732"}

{"@rid": "#420:31", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Dysmenorrhea refers to painful menstruation, typically characterized by cramping pain in the lower abdomen during the menstrual period. It may also be accompanied by symptoms such as backache, nausea, or fatigue.", "name": "Dysmenorrhea", "id": "733"}

{"@rid": "#420:32", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Dysuria refers to painful, burning, or uncomfortable urination. It is commonly associated with infections or inflammation of the urinary tract but may occur due to other urinary or genital conditions.", "name": "Dysuria", "id": "734"}

{"@rid": "#420:33", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Eczema is a skin disorder characterized by Itching erythema, Scaling, Edema, vesiculation, and Discharge", "name": "Eczema", "id": "735"}

{"@rid": "#420:34", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Endometrial calcification refers to the abnormal deposition of calcium within the endometrial lining of the uterus.", "name": "Endometrial Calcification", "id": "736"}

{"@rid": "#420:35", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "An endometrioma is a cyst formed when endometrial-like tissue grows within the ovary, commonly resulting from endometriosis.", "name": "Endometrioma", "id": "737"}

{"@rid": "#420:36", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Epidermolysis bullosa (EB) is a group of inherited rare skin disorders that causes the skin to become fragile and blister easily due to minor trauma or friction.", "name": "Epidermolysis Bullosa", "id": "738"}

{"@rid": "#420:37", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Episodic cluster headache is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of severe, usually one-sided headache, often accompanied by symptoms such as tearing, nasal congestion, or redness of the eye on the affected side.", "name": "Episodic Cluster Headache", "id": "739"}

{"@rid": "#420:38", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Psoriasis is a noninfectious chronic inflammatory skin disorder, characterized by well-defined erythematous plaques with silvery scales.", "name": "Erythrodermic Psoriasis", "id": "740"}

{"@rid": "#420:39", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma is a malignant tumor arising from the squamous epithelial cells lining the esophagus.", "name": "Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma", "id": "741"}

{"@rid": "#420:40", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Female infertility is the inability to achieve pregnancy after regular unprotected sexual intercourse for a defined period.", "name": "Female Infertility", "id": "742"}

{"@rid": "#420:41", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A fracture is a partial or complete break in the continuity of a bone, usually caused by trauma, excessive stress, or weakened bone. It may present with pain, swelling, deformity, and restricted movement.", "name": "Fracture", "id": "743"}

{"@rid": "#420:42", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Glaucoma is a group of eye disorders characterized by progressive damage to the optic nerve, often associated with elevated intraocular pressure.", "name": "Glaucoma", "id": "744"}

{"@rid": "#420:43", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Guillain Barre Syndrome (GB syndrome), a rare disease condition in which body’s immune system attacks part of the peripheral nervous system.", "name": "Guillain-Barre Syndrome", "id": "745"}

{"@rid": "#420:44", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Hemifacial spasm is a neurological disorder characterized by involuntary, intermittent contractions or twitching of the muscles on one side of the face.", "name": "Hemifacial Spasm", "id": "746"}

{"@rid": "#420:45", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Hepatitis B is a viral infection caused by the hepatitis B virus (HBV), primarily affecting the liver. It can cause acute or chronic liver inflammation and, in persistent cases, may lead to cirrhosis or liver cancer.", "name": "Hepatitis B", "id": "747"}

{"@rid": "#420:46", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Hirschsprung's disease is a congenital disorder in which certain portions of the large intestine lack normal nerve cells, resulting in impaired movement of intestinal contents.", "name": "Hirschsprung'S Disease", "id": "748"}

{"@rid": "#396:5", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Media_Type": "Amla Varga (Acidic Media)", "Preparation": "Kanji is prepared by fermenting a mixture of rice (or rice gruel) with water and souring agents (such as mustard or spices) for a specific period until it becomes acidic.", "name": "Sour Gruel", "Sanskrit_Name": "Kanji", "id": "128"}

{"@rid": "#396:6", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh ginger rhizomes were washed, crushed, and the juice was extracted by grinding and filtering through a clean cloth.", "name": "Trikshara:", "Sanskrit_Name": "Ardraka Swarasa", "id": "129"}

{"@rid": "#396:7", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh betel leaves were washed, crushed, and the juice was extracted by grinding and filtering through a clean cloth.", "name": "Betel Leaf Juice", "Sanskrit_Name": "Nagavalli Swarasa, Tambula Patra Swarasa", "id": "130"}

{"@rid": "#396:8", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Trikshara was prepared by mixing the three alkaline salts—Yavakshara, Sarjikshara, and Tankana (or as specified in the classical formulation)—into a fine homogeneous powder.", "name": "Trikshara", "id": "131"}
{"@rid": "#396:9", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Decoction prepared from whole plant of Sphaeranthus indicus Linn.", "name": "Mundi Kwatha", "id": "132"}

{"@rid": "#396:10", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Decoction prepared from leaves of Amra (Mangifera indica), Jambu (Syzygium cumini), Kapittha (Limonia acidissima), Bilwa (Aegle marmelos), Bijapuraka (Citrus medica) boiled in water.", "name": "Panchapallava Kwatha", "id": "133"}

{"@rid": "#396:11", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Aromatic herbal Decoction prepared by boiling Twakpatri (leaves of Cinnamomum zeylanicum Breyn.), Patraka (leaves of Cinnamomum tamala N.), Ushira (roots of Vetiveria zizanoides L.), Musta (tubers of Cyperus rotundus L.), Balamula (roots of Sida cordifolia L., and Kushta (roots of Saussurea lappa CB Clarke) in water.", "name": "Gandhodaka", "id": "134"}

{"@rid": "#396:12", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Crushed Neem leaves and Turmeric rhizome were boiled in water and filtered to obtain a herbal decoction", "name": "Neem-Turmeric Decoction", "id": "135"}

{"@rid": "#396:14", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh or dried Babool (Acacia arabica) bark was boiled in water until the volume was reduced, then filtered to obtain the decoction.", "name": "Babool bark decoction", "Sanskrit_Name": "Babool Chhal Kwatha", "id": "137"}

{"@rid": "#396:15", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Media_Type": "Kshara Varga (Alkaline Media)", "Preparation": "Churnodaka (lime water) was prepared by mixing lime powder (calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH)₂) with water, allowing it to stand for 12-24 hours and filtering the clear supernatant.", "name": "Lime Water", "Sanskrit_Name": "Churnodaka", "id": "138"}

{"@rid": "#396:17", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Media_Type": "Madhura Varga (sweet)", "Preparation": "Fresh Kushmanda (ash gourd) pulp was crushed and manually squeezed to extract the juice, which was then filtered for use.", "name": "Kushmanda Juice", "Sanskrit_Name": "Kusmanda Swarasa", "id": "140"}

{"@rid": "#396:19", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh Eclipta alba was washed, cut, blended for with distilled water, and the pulp was squeezed through cotton cloth to obtain fresh extract.", "name": "Eclipta Alba Juice", "Sanskrit_Name": "Bhringaraja Swarasa", "id": "142"}

{"@rid": "#396:23", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh roses (600 g) were soaked in water (6000 ml), mashed, and mildly distilled for 6 hours. The initial steam is discarded to yield about 2500 ml of Rose water (Gulaba Arka).", "name": "Rose Water", "Sanskrit_Name": "Gulaba arka", "id": "146"}
{"@rid": "#396:24", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Juice of Sesbania grandiflora leaves", "name": "Jayanti Patra Swarasa", "id": "147"}

{"@rid": "#396:31", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Media_Type": "Kshara Varga (Alkaline Media)", "Preparation": "Coarsely powdered Dolichos biflorus (Horse gram) was boiled with water (generally 1:16 ratio) until reduced to one-fourth, then filtered to obtain Kulattha Kwatha.", "name": "Horse Gram Decoction", "Sanskrit_Name": "Kulattha Kwatha", "id": "154"}

{"@rid": "#396:32", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Leaves of Vitex negundo (Nirgundi) and powder of Curcuma longa (turmeric) were boiled in water (typically 1:16 ratio) and reduced to one-fourth, then filtered to obtain the decoction.", "name": "Nirgundi -Turmeric Decoction", "id": "155"}

{"@rid": "#396:33", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Triphala Kwatha is prepared by boiling equal parts of Emblica officinalis, Terminalia bellirica, and Terminalia chebula in water and reducing it to one-fourth, then filtering the decoction.", "name": "Triphala Kwatha", "id": "156"}

{"@rid": "#396:34", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Whole plant of Plectranthus coesta (root, stem, leaves, flowers, fruits) dried and coarsely powdered.", "name": "Plectranthus coesta Powder", "Sanskrit_Name": "Chichiri Panchanga", "id": "157"}

{"@rid": "#396:35", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh leaves of Adhatoda vasica are crushed and squeezed to obtain juice, used as levigation (Bhavana) medium for trituration.", "name": "Adhatoda vasica Leaf Juice", "Sanskrit_Name": "Vasa Swarasa", "id": "158"}

{"@rid": "#396:42", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Decoction prepared by boiling coarse powder or fresh leaves of Nirgundi (Vitex negundo) in water and reducing to one-fourth volume, then filtering for use as liquid medium.", "name": "Nirgundi Decoction", "id": "165"}

{"@rid": "#396:43", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Powder prepared by collecting the whole plant (root, stem, leaves, flowers, and seeds) of Apamarga (Achyranthes aspera), cleaning, shade-drying, and grinding into a coarse powder.", "name": "Apamarga Panchanga Powder", "id": "166"}

{"@rid": "#396:44", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh juice obtained by washing, peeling, and crushing the fleshy leaf pulp of Aloe vera and filtering the expressed liquid for use as media.", "name": "Aloe Vera Juice", "Sanskrit_Name": "Kumari Swarasa", "id": "167"}
{"@rid": "#396:47", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Ficus religiosa bark powder", "name": "Peepal Bark Powder", "Sanskrit_Name": "Ashwattha Twak Churna", "id": "170"}
{"@rid": "#396:48", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Tamarindus indica bark powder", "name": "Tamarind Bark Powder", "Sanskrit_Name": "Cinca Twak Curna", "id": "171"}
{"@rid": "#396:50", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "name": "Decoctions of whole plant of Kantakari (Solanum xanthocarpum)", "id": "173"}
{"@rid": "#396:52", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "name": "Decoctions of dry pericarp of Bibhitaka (Terminalia bellirica)", "id": "175"}

{"@rid": "#396:53", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Media_Type": "Kshara Varga (Alkaline Media)", "Preparation": "Sarjika Salila is prepared by dissolving Sarjika Kshara (alkaline sodium salt powder) in water and stirring well until a clear mildly alkaline solution is obtained.", "name": "Sarjika Salila", "id": "176"}
{"@rid": "#396:54", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "A Decoction of turmeric in water", "name": "Turmeric Decoction", "Sanskrit_Name": "Haridra Kwatha", "id": "177"}
{"@rid": "#396:55", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "name": "Decoction of roots of Vata (Ficus benghalensis)", "Sanskrit_Name": "Nyagrodha Mula Kwatha", "id": "178"}
{"@rid": "#396:59", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Decoction of Bauhinia variegata stem bark", "name": "Kanchanara Kwatha", "id": "182"}
{"@rid": "#396:65", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "name": "Juice of Rhizome of Musa paradisiaca Linn", "Sanskrit_Name": "Kadali Rasa, Rambha Rasa", "id": "188"}

{"@rid": "#396:79", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh or dried Badari (Ziziphus jujuba) fruits were boiled in water until the volume was reduced (typically to one-fourth), then filtered to obtain Badari Kwatha (decoction).", "name": "Badari Kwatha", "id": "202"}
{"@rid": "#396:80", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "name": "Citrus Medica Juice", "Sanskrit_Name": "Bijora Nimbu Swarasa, Nimbu Swarasa", "id": "203"}
{"@rid": "#396:82", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh leaf juice of Cassia Oxidentalis Linn. plant", "name": "Kasamarda Swarasa", "id": "205"}

{"@rid": "#396:83", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Curd whey, is the nutrient-rich, yellowish supernatant liquid separated from curd. It is the liquid left behind after curdling milk.", "name": "Curd Whey", "Sanskrit_Name": "Dadhi Mastu", "id": "206"}

{"@rid": "#396:84", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Gomutra Triphala Kashaya is an Ayurvedic decoction made by boiling Triphala (Haritaki, Bibhitaki, Amalaki) in cow urine until reduced to the desired volume and then filtering for use.", "name": "Gomutra Triphala Kashaya", "id": "207"}
{"@rid": "#396:85", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Barley ash was dissolved in water, filtered and evaporated to obtain alkaline Yavakshara.", "name": "Yavakshara", "id": "208"}
{"@rid": "#396:86", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Purified guggulu resin was dissolved in water, filtered and used as the liquid medium.", "name": "Guggulu Decoction", "id": "209"}

{"@rid": "#396:88", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Suveeraka is a fermented sour liquid prepared by fermenting cereal flour (commonly barley or wheat) with water until it becomes acidic, then filtering before use.", "name": "Suveeraka", "id": "211"}

{"@rid": "#396:89", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh ripe Lakucha (Artocarpus hirsutus) fruits were washed, crushed or pressed, and the juice was filtered through a clean cloth to obtain fresh Lakucha Swarasa.", "name": "Artocarpus Hirsutus Juice", "Sanskrit_Name": "Lakucha Swarasa", "id": "212"}

{"@rid": "#396:90", "@type": "Media", "@cat": "v", "Preparation": "Fresh ginger rhizomes were washed, crushed, and the juice was extracted by grinding and filtering through a clean cloth.", "name": "Ginger Juice", "Sanskrit_Name": "Ardraka Swarasa", "id": "284"}

{"@rid": "#388:0", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Bhavana", "Method_Description": "Bhavana is the process of triturating a powdered drug with liquid media such as herbal juice, decoction, cow urine, milk, or other prescribed liquids. Grinding continues until the liquid is completely absorbed and the material becomes soft and homogeneous. This process helps detoxify, enhance potency, and incorporate the therapeutic properties of the liquid medium into the drug.", "id": "109"}

{"@rid": "#388:1", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Swedana", "Method_Description": "Swedana involves heating the raw material in a liquid medium using mild heat, usually by boiling or steaming (often in a Dolayantra setup). The process removes impurities, reduces toxicity, softens the material, and facilitates further purification or processing.", "id": "110"}

{"@rid": "#388:2", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Nimajjana", "Method_Description": "Nimajjana is the immersion of a substance in a specific liquid medium for a fixed duration. This allows soluble impurities or toxic components to leach out into the liquid, making the material safer and easier to process.", "id": "111"}

{"@rid": "#388:3", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Mardana", "Method_Description": "Mardana is dry or semi-wet grinding of substances in a mortar and pestle, sometimes with minimal liquid. It reduces particle size, improves homogeneity, and may help reduce toxicity by physical transformation and intimate mixing.", "id": "112"}

{"@rid": "#388:4", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Bharjana", "Method_Description": "Bharjana is heating the drug in a pan, often without liquid or with minimal ghee or sand, until desired color or texture changes occur. This process removes moisture, reduces toxicity, and improves digestibility and stability.", "id": "113"}

{"@rid": "#388:5", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Dhalana", "Method_Description": "In Dhalana, a substance is melted and then poured into a liquid medium such as oil, milk, or herbal decoction. The sudden cooling helps remove impurities and alter the physical structure, improving safety and medicinal properties.", "id": "114"}

{"@rid": "#388:6", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Nirvapa", "Method_Description": "Nirvapa involves heating the material until red hot and then quenching it immediately in a liquid medium. This cycle may be repeated multiple times. It reduces hardness and toxicity, enhances brittleness, and facilitates further processing.", "id": "115"}

{"@rid": "#388:7", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Urdhva Patana", "Method_Description": "Urdhva Patana Shodhana is a purification method in which the volatile purified component is separated from impurities by upward sublimation and collected in an upper vessel through controlled heating.", "id": "116"}

{"@rid": "#388:8", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Bhavana with heating", "Method_Description": "This is a modified Bhavana where trituration with liquid media is combined with gentle heating. Heat accelerates chemical transformations, enhances absorption of the liquid medium, and improves detoxification and therapeutic efficacy.", "id": "117"}

{"@rid": "#388:9", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Nisechana", "Method_Description": "Nisechana is the process of rapidly cooling a heated material by immersing it in a liquid medium, which helps remove impurities and improves its physical properties for further processing.", "id": "118"}

{"@rid": "#388:10", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Nirmalikarana", "Method_Description": "It is a specialized Shodhana process involving the dissolution, filtration, and recrystallization of a substance to remove physical impurities and obtain a purified crystalline product.", "id": "119"}

{"@rid": "#388:11", "@type": "Shodhana_Method", "@cat": "v", "name": "Prakshalana", "Method_Description": "Prakshalana is the process of thoroughly washing a drug with water or other prescribed liquids to remove surface impurities, dirt, soluble toxins, and unwanted residues.", "id": "120"}

{"@rid": "#392:0", "@type": "Shodhana_Type", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Samanya Shodhana (General purification) is the preliminary, common purification step applied to many metals, minerals, and toxic herbs using standard media such as water, cow urine, milk, oil, or herbal decoctions. Its purpose is to remove visible impurities, reduce basic toxicity, and make the material softer and suitable for further processing.", "name": "Samanya Shodhana", "id": "121"}

{"@rid": "#392:1", "@type": "Shodhana_Type", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Vishesh Shodhana (Specific purification) is the drug-specific purification performed after Samanya Shodhana. It uses special media and procedures tailored to a particular substance to eliminate its unique toxic components and enhance its therapeutic safety and efficacy.", "name": "Vishesha Shodhana", "id": "122"}

g.title: {"@rid": "#416:0", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.", "name": "Marana", "id": "692"}

{"@rid": "#416:1", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Dhanyabhraka is a special purification method for mica in which powdered mica is mixed with rice grains, tied in cloth, and soaked or rubbed in water. The fine mica particles pass through the cloth while heavier impurities remain behind.", "name": "Dhanyabhraka", "id": "693"}

{"@rid": "#416:2", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Amritikarana is a post-processing step applied to prepared Bhasma using ghee or herbal substances and mild heating. It is done to remove any residual toxicity, improve safety, and enhance therapeutic potency.", "name": "Amritikarana", "id": "694"}

{"@rid": "#416:3", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Bhanupaka involves triturating the drug with liquid media and exposing it to sunlight. The mild heat and UV exposure promote slow drying and gentle chemical transformation.", "name": "Bhanupaka", "id": "695"}

{"@rid": "#416:4", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Sthalipaka is cooking the drug with specific liquid media in a vessel over fire until the liquid evaporates. This helps detoxify the material and incorporate medicinal properties from the medium.", "name": "Sthalipaka", "id": "696"}

{"@rid": "#416:5", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Dhavana is the repeated washing of a substance with water or other liquids to remove soluble impurities, dirt, and unwanted soluble components.", "name": "Dhavana", "id": "697"}

{"@rid": "#416:6", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Jarana is roasting metals or minerals with herbal powders or other additives until they become brittle and powdery. It reduces hardness and prepares the substance for incineration (Marana).", "name": "Jarana", "id": "698"}

{"@rid": "#416:7", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Prakshalana is the process of thoroughly washing a drug with water or other prescribed liquids to remove surface impurities, dirt, soluble toxins, and unwanted residues. It is usually performed as a preliminary or intermediate purification step before further processing.", "name": "Prakshalana", "id": "699"}

{"@rid": "#416:8", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Bhavana is wet grinding of powdered drugs with herbal juices or decoctions until the liquid is fully absorbed. This enhances detoxification, potency, and homogeneity.", "name": "Bhavana", "id": "700"}

{"@rid": "#416:9", "@type": "Process", "@cat": "v", "Process_Description": "Lohitikarana is a treatment process that gives certain Bhasmas a reddish color through controlled heating and media treatment, indicating proper processing and improved therapeutic quality.", "name": "Lohitikarana", "id": "701"}
{"@rid": "#444:1", "@type": "Therapy", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A medicated decoction-based enema administered through the anal route.", "name": "Asthapana Basti", "id": "2395"}
{"@rid": "#444:2", "@type": "Therapy", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Application of medicinal preparation to the eyes.", "name": "Anjana Karma", "id": "2396"}
{"@rid": "#444:3", "@type": "Therapy", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Therapy promoting downward movement and reducing excess tissue.", "name": "Anulomana Lekhana", "id": "2397"}
{"@rid": "#444:5", "@type": "Therapy", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Pouring warm Dashamoola-infused milk over half of the body.", "name": "Ardhangam Dashamoola Ksheera Dhara", "id": "2399"}
{"@rid": "#444:6", "@type": "Therapy", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Therapeutic covering or wrapping of the body.", "name": "Avagundana", "id": "2400"}
{"@rid": "#444:7", "@type": "Therapy", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Milk-based medicated enema prepared with Baladi drugs.", "name": "Baladi Ksheera Basti", "id": "2401"}
{"@rid": "#444:9", "@type": "Therapy", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Therapeutic administration of medicine through the rectal route.", "name": "Basti", "id": "2403"}
